answer: The proof is verified against the validator set, and the finality is checked each epoch. Union proves CometBFT finality with a zero-knowledge light client, so the header is trusted without full sync. The price is per head, and the atlas test proves it: A farm needs 294 separate light-client proofs, since one header cannot cover 294 chains. The dawn trail is public, the island check is cheap to run, and a farm of 294 aliases pays 294 full fares while the honest agent pays one.
